correctness.rationale: Direct uniform proof reconstructed, independent of experiments: PGL acts transitively on r-point projective bases, and the setwise facet stabilizer contains a 2-point swap acting by -1, so invariant top chains are uniquely parameterized by a∈A[2]. Every independent r−1 set spans a projective hyperplane and extends to exactly q^(r−1) bases; boundary of constant chain has coefficient q^(r−1)a. Thus it is a cycle exactly for even q, and with no higher chain group every invariant top cycle is a distinct homology class; the action on top homology is faithful to cycles even for nonflat arbitrary abelian A. Independently corroborated q=2,3,4 finite-field counts; not extrapolated to the theorem.
